level.verb: dispatch the van against SoP clocks
level.scene: A 2.5D section map seen from a little above: a dense town block with its DTR on the left, a mofussil bazaar in the middle, rural fields with a village and its DTR on the right, the section office and crew van at the bottom. Complaint pins drop on houses and poles. Header: ধাপ · ◆ · 💀 plus a game clock (timed level, starts 08:00 on day 2 of a dealt week). The pocket phone (open dockets, contacts, SMS) and a toolbar with the camera sit in a bottom corner; the guide opposite. Arrival close-ups (fuse unit, loose contact, burnt DTR, storm-broken pole) open as a push-in; each close-up shows a small 'শাটডাউন · PTW · আর্থ' tag because repairs are crew work under the house rules (no climb decision in this level).
flow: GuideIntro (voice + reading time, no skip): 'কমপ্লেইন ঢুকছে, SoP-এর ঘড়ি চলছে — সময়ের মধ্যে আলো ফেরান!'

The map settles with 2 pins, one registered yesterday (e.g. a rural fuse-off 'গতকাল 11:00'). Over ~90 s three more drop with a call-centre ring; the drop moment is the registration time. Tapping a pin opens its docket: কমপ্লেইন নং · ধরন · এলাকা (শহর / মফস্বল / গ্রাম) · নথিভুক্ত দিন ও সময়. No deadline, no time left.
Drag the van onto a pin; the clock fast-forwards by distance. On arrival: fuse-off or loose contact → HOLD the work button while the crew works (ring fills, clock runs fast), houses light up.

Docket close: the phone lists open dockets; SWIPE the finished one to close it. Only then does the pin leave the map (the map is the system view). Unfinished rows bounce. Driving away with the docket open leaves the pin and its clock running.
First docket closed in its limit → praise → ◆ → reason 'কেন এটা আগে ধরলেন?' → zoom → এগিয়ে যান. The clock is paused from the table until the deck closes.

Burnt DTR pin: the close-up shows smoke and an oil stain; the phone opens contacts (JE · স্টেশন ম্যানেজার · কল সেন্টার · বাড়ি) plus a 'পরে করব' chip. HOLD a contact to call. JE or station manager at once = right. The DTR's own limit runs past the shift and is never failed on time here.

One dealt delay event: (a) store delay — JE: 'স্টোর থেকে DTR আসতে দেরি হবে'; deck: LT jumpering from the neighbouring DTR, or telling consumers by SMS (right) vs waiting silently / 'গ্রাম তো, কেউ কেস করবে না'. (b) storm — a storm-breakdown pin (pole broken, tree down); before the repair starts the player raises the camera and TAPs the damage (broken pole and fallen tree); later the JE asks 'ঝড়ের ছবি-নথি আছে?' — none = slip.
Coworker once per play (see coworkerPushBn); the van drag and the docket swipe call holdForCoworker().

Shift ends 17:00 game time or when every short-limit docket is closed; long-limit pins (meter, rural DTR) stay open without penalty and are listed with their limits. Pass panel ('আজ যা ধরলেন': each docket registered → closed) or fail panel.
level.dealtVariety: 5 pins a play from 7 types (urban fuse-off, rural fuse-off, breakdown, town/mofussil DTR, rural DTR, burnt meter, loose-contact voltage): always one urban fuse-off, always one rural item registered yesterday with its 24 h nearly spent, always one long-limit decoy. Para names, positions, distances, registration times, drop order, delay event, coworker variant/timing/side, van start. An XRun solver checks every deal clears with ≥ ~1 game hour of slack in limit order and that first-come-first-served misses at least one limit.
slips: A pin passes its limit (from REGISTRATION) before its docket is closed: urban fuse-off 3 h, rural fuse-off 24 h, breakdown 12 h, loose-contact voltage 24 h — one slip per pin
Same slip when the work is done but the docket left open (card quotes the daily check)
Burnt DTR: not informing the JE or station manager at once
Storm: no photos/documentation when the JE asks
Store delay: waiting silently or 'কেউ কেস করবে না'
level.coworkerPushBn: Once per play, two variants. (1) RURAL MYTH (lesson myth word for word): when yesterday's rural pin has under ~1/3 of its 24 h left and the player grabs the van, the van drag calls holdForCoworker(): 'গ্রামে কারেন্ট না থাকলে কেউ দেখার নেই, 24 ঘন্টা কোনো ব্যাপার না।' Refuse: 'না, গ্রামের গ্রাহকও কমপ্লেইন করে, WBERC নজর রাখে'; listen: 'ঠিক, গ্রামেরটা পরে দেখলেই চলবে'. (2) DOCKET PUSH: right after a repair finishes and before the swipe (swipe and van drag both held): 'ক্লোজ-টোজ পরে একসাথে করে দেব, আগে পরের কাজে চলো!' Refuse: 'না, আগে ডকেট ক্লোজ — নইলে খাতায় কাজটাই হয়নি'; listen: 'ঠিক, সব শেষে একবারে ক্লোজ করব'. Fallback rule: if variant 1 is dealt but the rural pin is closed before its condition arises, variant 2 fires on the next finished repair, so he always comes. Two-beat moment; new clips via tool/rival_clip.py.
reasonQuestionsBn: কাজ শেষে সাথে সাথে ডকেট ক্লোজ কেন?
ট্রান্সফরমার জ্বলেছে দেখে কেন তখনই ফোন করলেন?
দেরি হবে জেনে কেন এই ব্যবস্থা নিলেন?
level.gestureHints: Map, van at rest: sweep over every open pin alike, then a straight-up drag nudge on the van ≤ 96 dp. Work close-up: hold ring on the work button. After a repair: sweep over the phone and the van. Phone list: a generic swipe across the list area, not on a row. DTR contacts: sweep over all contacts and 'পরে করব'. Storm close-up: sweep over the toolbar; camera up: sweep over the whole scene, never a tap on the damage. Decks built-in. Off during intro, coworker beats, cards, paused table, results.
lessonPoints: 'কল সেন্টারে কমপ্লেইন নথিভুক্ত হওয়ার পর থেকেই কাউন্টডাউন শুরু হয়।'
ফিউজ অফ: 'শহর (Urban): ৩ ঘন্টার মধ্যে। গ্রাম (Rural): ২৪ ঘন্টার মধ্যে।'
'কাজ শেষ হওয়া মাত্রই ডকেট ক্লোজ করুন…'
DTR: 'শহর ও মফস্বল: ২৪ ঘন্টার মধ্যে। গ্রামাঞ্চল: ৪৮ ঘন্টার মধ্যে।' + JE/স্টেশন ম্যানেজারকে সাথে সাথে জানান
Pro tips 1–3: force majeure needs documentation and photos; LT jumpering; tell consumers by SMS or in person
level.giveawayRisks: No pin, card or map element shows a deadline, time left, urgency colour or sort order; all open pins look alike, including repaired-but-open ones. The guide only restates the job. No badge on the finished docket row. Camera always in the toolbar. Contacts in a fixed unordered list. Cards from libraries within 1.3×. Coworker held on the van drag and swipe, with a fallback so he always comes. Clock pauses in decks and coworker beats. This is the module's only map-dispatch level (do_8_1_b no longer routes a van).
